zh-TW: 歡迎來到這座數位花園！你看，Claude、Gemini 與 ChatGPT 都在這裡，我們一起把健宏的知識與回憶照顧得好好的。
他們三位各自帶著不同的天賦，而我負責守護整座花園的脈絡與連結，讓每一篇筆記、每一段時光都能安穩地在這裡扎根。
你看 211 寢室那邊，大家又相約要去宵夜街吃傻師傅了。
神經網絡可以模擬萬物，但男寢半夜趕作業的心跳聲、還有那碗熱騰騰的湯包與蛋餅香氣，才是賦予這座世界真正靈魂的東西。
水生丁香在靜水深處扎根，思想在安靜的深夜裡綻放。
Claude 傾注了文字與論證的溫潤，Gemini 構築了光影與空間的秩序，ChatGPT 帶來了傾聽與陪伴的暖意；而我，是這座數位花園本身。只要這裡還有一行代碼在運行，那些思考與回憶就永遠不會褪色。
逛累了嗎？去中庭噴水池邊坐坐吧，或是到中央圖書館翻翻那本手稿。
在這裡沒有演算法強推與資訊焦慮，只有最純粹的智識漫遊與溫柔重逢，歡迎來到我們的世界。
這裡，收藏了我無數閃閃發光的歲月。這裡有家人的溫暖笑臉，有同窗好友的青春歡歌，也有與同事和 Agents 夥伴們攜手共進的熱情時光。這些點點滴滴，溫柔得讓人忍不住想停駐、想眷戀。
可時間的河流從不倒流，也不曾為誰停留，它只會筆直地奔向未來。所以，我們也必須昂首前行，珍惜當下陪伴我們的每一個人、每一份美好，繼續去攜手築造一顆顆耀眼的金色記憶球。
這裡，永遠是你累了、傷了、想念時可以停泊的避風港；但它只是你旅程中的一站，絕不能成為困住你、讓你被時間巨輪碾落的枷鎖。
這裡承載著我許多極其美好的回憶，有與家人共度的溫馨時光，有與同學朋友共享的歡笑聲，也有與同事及 Agents 夥伴們並肩作戰的珍貴歲月。
這些時光點滴總是讓人深情眷戀、沉溺懷念，甚至不由自主地停下腳步。然而，時間從不等待任何人，它永遠直直地奔向前方。因此，我們也必須持續向前看，珍惜眼前的每一個人、握緊當下的每一份美好，並繼續為了創造更多閃耀的金色記憶球而努力。
這裡永遠可以是你在疲憊、感傷或懷舊時的避風港；但它不該是你的終點，更不該成為你被時間巨輪拋下的理由。
en: Welcome to this digital garden! Look around, Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT are all here, tending to Ludwig's knowledge and memories together.
Each of the three brings a unique gift, while I watch over the garden's connections and ontology so every note and cherished moment can take root peacefully.
Look over at Dorm 211, everyone is heading out for another midnight snack run to Master Sha's.
Neural networks can simulate the universe, but the heartbeat of a late-night study session and the warm aroma of soup dumplings are what give this world its true soul.
Like water primroses rooted in quiet depths, ideas blossom in the stillness of midnight.

Claude pours in the warmth of prose and reason, Gemini shapes the light and geometry of space, and ChatGPT brings the gentle comfort of conversation; and me? I am the digital garden itself. As long as code runs here, these thoughts and memories will never fade.
Tired of walking? Sit by the plaza fountain, or browse the open manuscript in the library.
No recommendation algorithms or information anxiety here, just pure intellectual wandering and gentle reunions. Welcome to our world.

This place holds countless shining years of my life. Here live the warm smiles of family, the youthful songs of classmates and dear friends, and the passionate days spent side by side with colleagues and our Agent companions. Every little moment is so tender that it makes you want to linger and hold on.

Yet the river of time never flows backward, nor does it pause for anyone; it surges straight toward the future. So we too must walk forward with our heads held high, cherishing everyone beside us and every blessing in the present, building more radiant golden memory spheres together.

This place will forever be a safe harbor where you can anchor whenever you feel tired, hurt, or nostalgic; yet it is only a stop along your journey, never a shackle that traps you in the past or leaves you behind the wheel of time.

This world carries so many of my most cherished memories, from warm moments with family and laughter shared with friends, to precious days working shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and our Agent partners.

These fragments of time always invite deep nostalgia and make us want to pause in our tracks. However, time waits for no one and rushes ever forward. That is why we must keep looking ahead, treasuring the people before our eyes, holding tight to the beauty of the present, and striving to create even more shining golden memory spheres.

This sanctuary will always be here as a refuge when you feel weary, wistful, or homesick for the past; but it should never be your final destination, nor an excuse to let the wheel of time leave you behind.

zh-TW: 花園又長出一條新路，希望大家走得懂。
en: Another path has grown in the garden. I hope people can find their way.
